# Davon - AI-Powered Healthcare Equipment Monitoring

## About Davon
Davon is an AI-powered platform that revolutionizes healthcare equipment maintenance through predictive analytics and intelligent monitoring. We help hospitals and healthcare facilities optimize equipment performance, reduce downtime, and ensure patient safety.

## What We Do
- **Predictive Maintenance**: Use AI to anticipate equipment failures before they occur
- **Real-time Monitoring**: Track medical equipment across all hospital departments
- **Multi-system Integration**: Connect with existing CMMS, EHR, BMS, and IoT systems
- **Comprehensive Coverage**: Monitor MRI machines, CT scanners, ventilators, infusion pumps, and more

## Key Features
- AI-powered predictive analytics
- Real-time equipment monitoring
- Multi-hospital system support
- HIPAA-compliant data security
- Seamless system integrations
- 24/7 technical support

## Target Audience
- Clinical engineering teams
- Hospital IT departments
- Healthcare administrators
- Maintenance managers
- Biomedical technicians

## Technology Stack
- AI/ML-powered analytics
- Cloud-based infrastructure
- HL7/FHIR integration standards
- Real-time data processing
- Secure API connections
